ModMetaData.name: Mod Sync
ModMetaData.author: fnielson
ModMetaData.description:
Sync your active mods, load order and mod settings from a host's game to yours.
The host clicks "Mod Sync" on the main menu and starts hosting. Clients enter the host's address and click Sync: Workshop mods are subscribed through Steam, local mods are downloaded directly from the host, the mod list and mod settings are copied, and the game restarts.
Only sync from hosts you trust - you are downloading and running their mods.
